entries.mitigation: Burn both frost shields before the 15-second burst. Hailstone Burst cannot be blocked or dodged, so this is a hard DPS check.
entries.notes: Guide evidence records the 15-second wipe window; official U26 patch notes confirm Hailstone Burst cannot be blocked or dodged.

entries.mitigation: Kill totems quickly and react to the type: avoid Dragon fire lines, break free from Gargoyle stone, move from Harpy lightning, and spread for Chaurus poison.
Assign a boat runner and ballista support before 50%. Interrupt the Conjurer summon and clear the boat before extra waves snowball.
Kill the conduit immediately. Its chain damage and snare ramp quickly, and siege users are especially vulnerable if one lands on them.
Move Vrol out of Frigid Fog immediately so the group avoids the stun/damage ramp and the boss stops refreshing his shield.
Break the Sanguine Prison immediately. The trapped player dies after about 8 seconds if the prison survives.
Stop unnecessary movement during the 30-second coagulant phase and kill or control coagulants before they reach the center. More coagulants make the eruption worse.
Send the assigned upstairs DDs as soon as the cells open and kill both Torturers before they execute prisoners or join the main fight empowered.
